services.name: System_InitializeRuntime
services.behavior: Initializes the audio driver from the four ROM driver/resource pointers, queues the initial audio control command, clears runtime gates, installs the default menu control-layout pointer and terrain callbacks on first entry, and publishes the initial scene/transition/difficulty flags.

services.name: Startup_InitializeSceneState
services.behavior: Clears actor scratch, publishes SOUND_TEST_ENTRY_PTR=0x0012675E and SCENE_SCRIPT_CURSOR=0x00004082, selects SCENE_STATE=1, initializes the difficulty-based interaction counter, and sets ACTIVE_SCENE_ENTRY_GATE to 3, 1, or 0 for difficulty modes 0, 1, or other.

services.name: SceneResource_InitializeActiveScene
services.behavior: Consumes ACTIVE_SCENE_ENTRY_GATE; when set, initializes the active scene presentation and recurring resource/frame service before returning to the reset flow.

evidence.reset_order: Reset calls System_InitializeRuntime and Startup_InitializeSceneState before programming the initial VDP registers and entering the scene/resource presentation sequence.
evidence.one_time_install: System_InitializeRuntime checks the existing pointer at 0x00FF728C before installing the default menu control layout at ROM 0x00004036 and its three terrain callback pointers.
evidence.active_scene_gate: Startup_InitializeSceneState writes 0x00FF7E3F after the scene/script defaults and SceneResource_InitializeActiveScene returns immediately when that byte is clear.

limitations: The exact user-facing meaning of GAME_RUNTIME_MODE and STARTUP_FRAME_LIMIT is not assigned by this finding; both remain manifest-only context names.
The gate values 3, 1, and 0 are recorded as the ROM's mode-dependent initialization contract, not as a newly inferred enum beyond the active-scene entry use.
conclusion: The reset bootstrap is now represented as two named initialization services feeding the active-scene presentation gate. This separates one-time hardware/menu setup from reset-time scene/script defaults and from the later scene-resource renderer.
